lines: I just started too! Let's see who's faster.
npcs.speaker: Young Ranger Jay

lines: After battle: It likes you too, I think.
npcs.speaker: Young Ranger Amy

post: You fit. Take the Core Fragment. It opens roads that only a steady Ranger can open.
pre: A dojo is a machine. Every part has a place. Show me where you fit.

entries.music: town loop, dojo loop (tenser, same key)

lines: Welcome to the MochiiPlex. Your team is tired? Rest here. It is free, and it is always free.
npcs.speaker: MochiiPlex nurse

lines: Capture Cubes, Mend Patches, and a few Mochi Cards. Come back when you have more CR — the good stock comes with the badges.
npcs.speaker: MochiiPlex clerk

lines: Master Lin does not shout. He builds. Watch how his creatures stand.
npcs.speaker: Dojo 1 acolyte 1 (Core theme)

lines: The Mochi Garden is open now. Raise them here, feed them, race them, breed them. A creature you raise is stronger than a creature you only catch.
npcs.speaker: Mochiko, garden gate

entries.sprites: dojo interior (Kenney Furniture Kit CC0, restyled), Lin portrait (human-characters lane)
entries.team: ROSTER GAP Core creatures + Sproutle placeholder to be replaced when a Core roster species exists (placeholder recorded, not final)

lines: The docks are ours now. The data here flows where we say it flows.
antagonist.speaker: Hacker, docks

post: Take the Wind Fragment. The sky is a road too, once you learn to read it.
pre: Wind does not ask permission. Neither do I.

entries.kind: The Dark Forest, Route Emerald, Stoneport Dojo 2

lines: The woods hum. Listen, and you will hear where the wild ones are.
npcs.speaker: Woods Ranger, bug theme

entries.sprites: forest tiles (Kenney Tiny Town + 0x72 CC0), harbour tiles (Tiny City)
entries.team: ROSTER GAP until Aero species exist (Sproutle placeholder in the existing dojo_2 entry is NOT canon)

lines: The ferry runs on data, not diesel. Help me clear the Hacker cell on the ferry, and I will teach you Data-Cut. It cuts vines, and it cuts lies, if you use it right.
antagonist.speaker: Ferry captain

dojo.leader: ROSTER GAP leader name — Mars to name, do not invent
pre: Neon is bright because we keep it bright. Show me you can stand in the light.

entries.kind: Cave of Echoes, Signal Tunnel, Neon City Dojo 3
entries.music: cave loop (low, echo), neon loop (bright, synth)

lines: The cave echoes what you bring into it. Bring a steady team, and it echoes back steady.
npcs.speaker: Cave guide

entries.sprites: cave tiles (0x72 DungeonTileset II CC0), neon signs (Mochiichao-original, Y2K palette)

lines: The market sells everything, even the truth. We bought the truth first.
antagonist.speaker: Hideout leader

entries.kind: Pale Town Tower, Market City Dojo 4, Central City Dojo 5
entries.music: tower loop (somber), market loop (busy), HQ loop (tense)

lines: This tower remembers the first Rangers. The Syndicate is trying to rewrite what it remembers. Do not let them.
npcs.speaker: Tower keeper

lines: The tower is ours again. Thank you. The dojo is open — go, before they regroup.
npcs.speaker: Central citizen, after freeing

entries.sprites: tower interior (Furniture Kit CC0), market stalls (Tiny Town)
entries.town: Pale Town / Market City / Central City

post: Take the last badge. Victory Route is open. The Plateau is waiting. Hex is already there.
pre: You have followed us across the whole Mainframe. Good. Now you will stop, here, in the town where you started.

entries.kind: Harbor City Dojo 6, Ember Island Dojo 7, Silicon Town Dojo 8
entries.music: harbour loop, island loop, dojo 8 loop (boss)

lines: The preserve is not a zoo. It is a promise. Keep the promise, and I will teach you Wave-Ride. Water is a road, if you respect it.
npcs.speaker: Preserve keeper

lines: Log 7: The Mythic data is not a weapon. It is a memory. Whoever holds the memory holds the Mainframe. We buried it here so no one would hold it alone.
npcs.speaker: Mansion log (readable, not spoken)

entries.sprites: preserve tiles (Tiny Town farm / water), mansion interior (Furniture Kit)
entries.town: Harbor City / Ember Island / Silicon Town

post: You beat me. Good. Now the Hall is yours. Write your name in it, and do not let anyone erase it.
pre: I got here first. That is not a boast. It is a fact, and facts are all I have left to beat you with.
champion.speaker: Champion Hex (canon)

pre: I guard the door. Pass me, and you are no longer a visitor.
elite.speaker: ELITE 1 (NAME GAP)

pre: I guard the stairs. Climb, if you can.
elite.speaker: ELITE 2 (NAME GAP)

pre: I guard the hall. The hall remembers everyone who stood here.
elite.speaker: ELITE 3 (NAME GAP)

pre: I guard the champion's door. Knock twice, and mean it.
elite.speaker: ELITE 4 (NAME GAP)

lines: There. A second signal. A second Mainframe shard. The ferry can reach it, now that you cleared the isles. Take the ticket. Region 2 is waiting.
npcs.speaker: Prof. Aeon, on the last isle
